_classification: What each refusal judges. Keyed by the FUNCTION it sits in, with a few identified by a distinctive fragment of their own message where one function judges both a caller's arguments and a table's contents. NOT by file:line -- that version silently re-labelled 38 sites when the Catalan loader was inserted above them. `workbook` the user's own spreadsheet, `source` a file from a statistical office, `scenario` what they asked for, `upstream` a failure re-raised with guidance, `caller` an internal API contract, `data` the numbers themselves.
key_format: file.py::function, plus a fragment of the message when one function raises more than once. NOT file:line -- editing a module shifts every line below the edit, which silently re-labelled 38 sites once and broke this check again on 2026-09-01.
